lines.say: {drop}Drop a ball through a laser. {blk}It blocks the beam for a split second. {q}So, what's g?
Real OCR A-level question. {pz}Pause and try it!
{rw}Rewind. {sm}Slow motion. {b1}Beam blocked at point one oh seconds. {b2}Back on at point one four. {dt}That's point oh four seconds.
{d}In that time, the ball moves its own width: five centimetres. {v}So its average speed is one point two five metres per second.
{trap}But careful! {vt}The ball speeds up the whole time, in a straight line. {mid}So that average is its speed halfway. At point one two seconds.
{g}g is speed over time. One point two five over point one two. {ans}Ten point four!
{w1}Divide by point one four? Eight point nine three. {w2}By point one oh? Twelve point five. {w3}Both wrong!
{o}Try this question and more at TrainTanmay. Link in bio!
